citations.note: The Joint Systems Manufacturing Center (Lima Army Tank Plant) is co-located with the Shawnee campus in Allen County. The nexus is documented geography; the causal link to the boom remains an inference (the campus authorization posture is undisclosed).

#1480 documented negative search for a facility-naming federal-authorization instrument: USASpending/SAM.gov show no award or recipient for the Bistrozzi owner-of-record shell; the FedRAMP Marketplace lists Google Cloud service-wide, naming no Lima facility; and the Assured Workloads authorization model binds to the service, not an address, so a facility-scoped instrument cannot exist by construction. The authorization posture stays undisclosed and the JSMC co-location stays coincidental geography — no supply/authorization link was found or forced (cf. Urbana #1353).

The capture reading, and its limit (ME-D, issue 1663). BLS QCEW 2024 annual averages for Allen County (area 39003) put federal-government employment at 321 jobs across 15 establishments, averaging $83,773 a year against the county-wide $58,790 — a real wage premium on a small base. The location quotient is 0.33: the county's federal-employment share is a third of the national one. So the enclave does NOT read as a procurement economy on the payroll record, and the arsenal's own workforce is not what these numbers count — the JSMC is government-owned and contractor-operated, so its General Dynamics staff fall under private manufacturing, not the federal ownership row. QCEW also excludes uniformed active-duty entirely (the model's standing coverage caveat). What remains open is the instrument side: no abatement, PILOT, or public-benefit agreement tied to the JSMC footprint has been searched for or found, and the five federally-held parcels carry $14,688,900 of assessed market value across 384.15 acres with no local tax duty (data/reference/allen-gis/parcels.defense.yaml). Capture is a live question here, not a finding.
Inferred from the EV/battery supply corridor around Lordstown; no documented defense nexus yet — a watch-level signal only. Lordstown is a tracking candidate (Mahoning, #490).
The New Albany / Licking County semiconductor megasite is a documented CHIPS-program federal investment. New Albany is a tracking candidate (no SiteProfile yet, epic #485).

Springfield-Beckley Air National Guard Base is adjacent; the National Air and Space Intelligence Center (NASIC, at Wright-Patterson) is in the same corridor. Adjacency is documented; the NASIC linkage is the softer signal.
Wright-Patterson AFB sits at the Mad River terminus, adjacent to the watershed point. The base is the strongest documented federal-enclave signal in the network after Lima.
